title: Malaco, Chimneyville and the Stax and Atlantic tape
summary: Chimneyville was a Malaco subsidiary on a percentage deal; the tape with Groove Me and Mr. Big Stuff was sent to labels, Groove Me was released independently, and Atlantic and Stax took notice.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums
